use_cases.name: Authenticate User
use_cases.description: User logs in via SSO to access the dashboard

use_cases.name: View Dashboard
use_cases.description: User views KPI widgets with real-time data refreshed every 15 minutes

use_cases.name: Create Custom Report
use_cases.description: User selects metrics, applies date range filters, and generates a custom report

use_cases.name: Export Report
use_cases.description: User exports report to PDF or CSV format

use_cases.name: Schedule Report Delivery
use_cases.description: User configures automated report generation and email delivery on a schedule

use_cases.name: Configure Alert
use_cases.description: User sets threshold-based alerts that trigger notifications via PagerDuty

use_cases.name: Receive Alert Notification
use_cases.description: System sends alert to PagerDuty when threshold is breached
